_notes: Data only. Three levels per target. Levels 1 and 2 are one short line. Level 3 points at an object (arrow or highlight) or at a sketch pose. Shown only when asked.

dive:street: The shop door is open. Walk closer to it.
Hold the lens on the open doorway until the ring fills.
take_key: Something small lies on the counter.
Walk up to the counter and take the key.
unlock_blue_drawer: One drawer is not the same colour as the others, and it is locked.
Use the key on the blue drawer.
dive:shop: Look closer at the open drawer.
Hold the lens on the inside of the blue drawer.
open_envelope: One envelope near you has its flap up.
use_feather_on_nose: Use what was in the envelope.
Cats hate a feather on the nose.
dive:drawer: The cat stirred. Look closer at it.
Hold the lens on the fur of its neck.
dive:cat: The eye is open. Look closer.
Hold the lens on the eye until the ring fills.
cover_reflected_lamp: Look up at the wet shine of the eye.
Pupils widen in the dark. Cover the light.
dive:eye: Stand on the ring near the pupil.
Hold the lens on the round pupil.
take_light: Look into the small craters near where you landed.
One crater has a spark in it.
use_light_on_lamp: Stand by the old lamp on the rise.
Put the light in the lamp.
dive:moon: Stand by the lamp and look down to the left.
Hold the lens on the edge of the moon.
S1: It was drawn from the middle of the street.
Look up and to the left. Two roofs. Zoom in.
S2: It was drawn from the doorway.
The counter and the tall clock. Zoom a little.
S3: It was drawn from the top of the letter hill.
Look left and down. The bridge of keys over the ink.
S4: It was drawn from the collar.
Three charms in a row. The bell is in the middle.
S5: It was drawn from the edge of the iris.
Three stars in a line, with a ring crossing them.
S6: It was drawn from the rise, beside the lamp.
Look down and to the left, over the edge. The harbor.
street.umbrella: Behind the fish stall, on the harbor side.
Beside the oars, low down. Zoom.
street.ship_bottle: A lit window across the street.
On the outside sill, first floor. Zoom right in.
shop.teacup_star: The high cups, behind you when you face the chest of drawers.
Twelve cups. One has a star.
shop.marble: At the counter's foot, near the mouse hole.
drawer.stamp_moon: Near the top. A night sky with a hole.
cat.flea: On one hair, high up. Zoom right in.
cat.fishbone: Where the fur meets the collar.
eye.comet: Between the rings, from the ring near the pupil.
eye.lighthouse_reflection: The wet shine, from the iris edge.
Something very small has a light on top.
moon.footprint: The dust near where you landed.
By a crater rim, to the left.
moon.glove: A small crater near where you landed.
